narration:1:1460115001:1.text: After a long journey, you leave the Ashen Wastes and arrive at Holistone.
narration:1:1460115001:1.source_cn: 一番跋涉后，你们离开了荒角沙漠，抵达了圣石镇。

narration:2:1460115002:0.text: Covered in dust from travel, you make your way to the Traveler's Light.
narration:2:1460115002:0.source_cn: 风尘仆仆的你们，决定先前往旅人灯火稍事休息。

narration:3:1460115003:0.text: There, you see another familiar figure...
narration:3:1460115003:0.source_cn: 没想到，在那里，你们看到另一个熟悉的身影……

say:6:1460115004:1.text: Oh? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what brings you here all of a sudden?
say:6:1460115004:1.male: Oh? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what brings you here all of a sudden?
say:6:1460115004:1.female: Oh? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what brings you here all of a sudden?

say:7:1460115005:1.text: Pull up a chair! Want a drink? It's on me!
say:7:1460115005:1.source_cn: 请坐请坐。要不要来杯麦酒？我请客！
say:7:1460115005:1.male: Pull up a chair! Want a drink? It's on me!
say:7:1460115005:1.female: Pull up a chair! Want a drink? It's on me!

say:8:1460115006:1.text: Valen, why are you drinking in broad daylight? Why are you here?
say:8:1460115006:1.source_cn: 维伦，你怎么大白天的就在喝酒？

say:9:1460115007:1.text: I should be asking you that. The General's away at the capital, who knows when he'll be back.
say:9:1460115007:1.source_cn: 我还想问你们呢，将军在帝都述职，也不知道什么时候回来。

say:10:1460115008:1.text: But you lot? Already diving headfirst into another adventure—and with a new companion, no less!
say:10:1460115008:1.source_cn: 反而你们已经开始了愉快的新冒险——还带来了一位新朋友。

say:12:1460115009:1.text: It's a pleasure to meet you. I'm Pang, a traveler from a far-off land.
say:12:1460115009:1.source_cn: 幸会，我是潘，来自遥远异国，前来访问的旅人。

say:13:1460115010:0.text: Likewise. I'm the guy officially assigned to watch over <style="stress"><player_name></style> while he's in the empire.
say:13:1460115010:0.male: Likewise. I'm the guy officially assigned to watch over <style="stress"><player_name></style> while he's in the empire.
say:13:1460115010:0.female: Likewise. I'm the guy officially assigned to watch over <style="stress"><player_name></style> while she's in the empire.

say:14:1460115011:1.text: Of course, I also handle some minor duties—such as keeping order in Holistone.
say:14:1460115011:1.source_cn: 当然，还有一些微不足道的其他工作——比如目前就在代管圣...

say:15:1460115012:1.text: You're clearly slacking off right now!
say:15:1460115012:1.source_cn: 你明明就是在喝酒偷懒！

say:16:1460115013:1.text: Not slacking, Hammie! This is part of the other duties I just mentioned.
say:16:1460115013:1.source_cn: 不不不，亲爱的漫漫小姐，这也是我刚刚说的“其他工作”之一。

say:17:1460115014:1.text: Of course, it's the more... discreet part of the work.
say:17:1460115014:1.source_cn: 当然，是比较不可告人的那一部分。

say:18:1460115015:0.text: You'd be amazed at what people spill over a few drinks. Gossip, rumors, shady secrets—
say:18:1460115015:0.source_cn: 你要知道，这酒馆向来是小道消息最为丰富，也最热闹的地方。

say:19:1460115016:1.source_cn: 我在这里监控，可是完全的尽职尽责。

say:20:1460115017:1.text: Sure sounds convenient when you put it like that...
say:20:1460115017:1.source_cn: 说得倒是有道理，可被你这么一说，就觉得是在找借口……

say:21:1460115018:0.text: Let me prove it! Word is, there've been sightings of a mysterious warrior and a powerful mage popping up all over the place.
say:21:1460115018:0.source_cn: 那不如我说说看——来自异国的武士，在了不起的大魔法师的...
say:21:1460115018:0.male: Let me prove it! Word is, there've been sightings of a mysterious warrior and a powerful mage popping up all over the place.
say:21:1460115018:0.female: Let me prove it! Word is, there've been sightings of a mysterious warrior and a powerful mage popping up all over the place.

say:22:1460115019:1.text: You mean Master Pang? He just introduced himself!
say:22:1460115019:1.source_cn: 这是刚刚潘自己介绍的！

say:23:1460115020:0.text: Sure, but let me add some spice. This warrior's clearly skilled—but refuses to fight. Odd, right?
say:23:1460115020:0.source_cn: 那补充点信息，这位武士虽然一看就知道有着高超的技艺，但...

choice_prompt:24:1460115020.text: Sure, but let me add some spice. This warrior's clearly skilled—but refuses to fight. Odd, right?
choice_prompt:24:1460115020.source_cn: 那补充点信息，这位武士虽然一看就知道有着高超的技艺，但因为奇怪的原因只动嘴不动手？

say:25:1460115021:2.text: I understand your curiosity. Even in my homeland, such behavior would earn its share of puzzled looks.
say:25:1460115021:2.source_cn: 我能理解，即使在我的故乡，这种做法也有些古怪。
say:25:1460115021:2.male: I understand your curiosity. Even in my homeland, such behavior would earn its share of puzzled looks.
say:25:1460115021:2.female: I understand your curiosity. Even in my homeland, such behavior would earn its share of puzzled looks.

say:26:1460115022:1.text: Let me think of a comparison... hmm. It's like solving a difficult math problem.
say:26:1460115022:1.source_cn: 让我想想比喻……唔，就像是在证明某道数学题一样。
say:26:1460115022:1.male: Let me think of a comparison... hmm. It's like solving a difficult math problem.
say:26:1460115022:1.female: Let me think of a comparison... hmm. It's like solving a difficult math problem.

say:27:1460115024:1.text: When faced with a challenge, it's wise to study how others have overcome theirs—it gives us perspective.
say:27:1460115024:1.source_cn: 在做一道难题时，可以去学习其他人的解题方式来获得灵感。

say:28:1460115025:1.text: But if you begin solving their problems instead of your own... you may forget the question you were meant to answer.
say:28:1460115025:1.source_cn: 但是动手去解其他人的题目，这就会影响专注，甚至导致分心了。

say:29:1460115026:1.text: Valen, how did you know such specific details? It hasn't even been that long since we met Master Pang!
say:29:1460115026:1.source_cn: 啊，维伦，你怎么会知道这么细节的消息啊？

say:30:1460115027:1.text: Maybe because I'm very committed to my "other duties"?
say:30:1460115027:1.source_cn: 大概是因为我很专注地在做我的“其他工作”？

choice_prompt:31:1460115027.text: Maybe because I'm very committed to my "other duties"?
choice_prompt:31:1460115027.source_cn: 大概是因为我很专注地在做我的“其他工作”？

say:32:1460115028:1.text: Are you doubting my skills? Or just my ability to stay focused?
say:32:1460115028:1.source_cn: 你是不相信我的工作能力，还是只是不相信我会“专注”？
say:32:1460115028:1.male: Are you doubting my skills? Or just my ability to stay focused?
say:32:1460115028:1.female: Are you doubting my skills? Or just my ability to stay focused?

say:33:1460115029:0.text: How heartbreaking... If I'm right, you'll owe me a drink.
say:33:1460115029:0.source_cn: 真伤心啊，要是我说准了，等会儿你可要请我喝一杯。
say:33:1460115029:0.male: How heartbreaking... If I'm right, you'll owe me a drink.
say:33:1460115029:0.female: How heartbreaking... If I'm right, you'll owe me a drink.

say:34:1460115031:0.text: Here's something juicy: that famous swordsman—the Scion of the Lucent Tree? He's been trying to reestablish safe passage back to the Dark Forest.
say:34:1460115031:0.source_cn: 那么另一个情报——那位备受瞩目的剑士，流荧树之子，最近...

say:35:1460115032:1.text: But without strong connections, it's gonna be a while.
say:35:1460115032:1.source_cn: 只不过他在这方面人脉不够广阔，所以估计还要多花点时间。

say:36:1460115033:1.text: So Eironn's not returning anytime soon... guess it's a good thing we didn't wait around.
say:36:1460115033:1.source_cn: 啊，埃隆果然要耽搁一阵子才能回薄暮丛林呢，幸好我们没在...
say:36:1460115033:1.male: So Eironn's not returning anytime soon... guess it's a good thing we didn't wait around.
say:36:1460115033:1.female: So Eironn's not returning anytime soon... guess it's a good thing we didn't wait around.

say:37:1460115034:0.text: That tidbit alone is worth a round of your best ale, don't you think?
say:37:1460115034:0.source_cn: 这消息如何？值一杯梅林亲自请客的美味麦酒吧？
say:37:1460115034:0.male: That tidbit alone is worth a round of your best ale, don't you think?
say:37:1460115034:0.female: That tidbit alone is worth a round of your best ale, don't you think?

choice_prompt:38:1460115034.source_cn: 这消息如何？值一杯梅林亲自请客的美味麦酒吧？
choice_prompt:38:1460115034.male: That tidbit alone is worth a round of your best ale, don't you think?
choice_prompt:38:1460115034.female: That tidbit alone is worth a round of your best ale, don't you think?

say:39:1460115035:1.text: Perfect. Put it on your tab. And fair warning—the next one's premium content.
say:39:1460115035:1.source_cn: 不错，那么记在账上，接下来的情报就要以一换一了。
say:39:1460115035:1.male: Perfect. Put it on your tab. And fair warning—the next one's premium content.
say:39:1460115035:1.female: Perfect. Put it on your tab. And fair warning—the next one's premium content.

say:40:1460115037:1.text: Here's your third piece: word is the Maulers have been up to something. Seems they're preparing for a big event.
say:40:1460115037:1.source_cn: 第三个情报，我听说蛮血部落前两天就热闹起来，似乎要筹备...
say:40:1460115037:1.male: Here's your third piece: word is the Maulers have been up to something. Seems they're preparing for a big event.
say:40:1460115037:1.female: Here's your third piece: word is the Maulers have been up to something. Seems they're preparing for a big event.

say:41:1460115038:1.text: If that goes public, a lot of folks will take interest—if you can give me an answer, I'll pass the info around.
say:41:1460115038:1.source_cn: 这件事如果公开，想必各方都会关注——如果你们能给我一个...
say:41:1460115038:1.male: If that goes public, a lot of folks will take interest—if you can give me an answer, I'll pass the info around.
say:41:1460115038:1.female: If that goes public, a lot of folks will take interest—if you can give me an answer, I'll pass the info around.

say:42:1460115039:1.text: That way, everyone stays informed, my job's done, and I can continue slacking off guilt-free. Win-win, right?
say:42:1460115039:1.source_cn: 这样，各方面都安定下来，我完成了工作，也能心安理得地在...
say:42:1460115039:1.male: That way, everyone stays informed, my job's done, and I can continue slacking off guilt-free. Win-win, right?
say:42:1460115039:1.female: That way, everyone stays informed, my job's done, and I can continue slacking off guilt-free. Win-win, right?

choice_prompt:43:1460115039.female: That way, everyone stays informed, my job's done, and I can continue slacking off guilt-free. Win-win, right?

say:44:1460115040:1.text: Loafing? This is covert intelligence gathering. I'm basically the Empire's most charming shadow.
say:44:1460115040:1.source_cn: 别这么严厉嘛，我这灵通的消息不已经证明了我的勤奋吗？
say:44:1460115040:1.male: Loafing? This is covert intelligence gathering. I'm basically the Empire's most charming shadow.
say:44:1460115040:1.female: Loafing? This is covert intelligence gathering. I'm basically the Empire's most charming shadow.

say:45:1460115042:1.text: But I'll throw in a bonus. Word is, Master Pang here may not fight, but he's got an eye sharper than most blades.
say:45:1460115042:1.source_cn: 那么，再加个筹码吧？听闻这位潘先生尽管无法动手，但是很...
say:45:1460115042:1.male: But I'll throw in a bonus. Word is, Master Pang here may not fight, but he's got an eye sharper than most blades.
say:45:1460115042:1.female: But I'll throw in a bonus. Word is, Master Pang here may not fight, but he's got an eye sharper than most blades.

say:46:1460115043:1.text: And I've been itching for a good stretch. Care for a little spar?
say:46:1460115043:1.source_cn: 正好我也很久没活动筋骨了，要不要我们来练习一下？
say:46:1460115043:1.male: And I've been itching for a good stretch. Care for a little spar?
say:46:1460115043:1.female: And I've been itching for a good stretch. Care for a little spar?

say:47:1460115044:1.text: Didn't you say you wanted to see the Lightbearer knights in action, Master Pang?
say:47:1460115044:1.source_cn: 而且，这也算是满足潘想要“见识耀光帝国骑士”的心愿吧？
say:47:1460115044:1.male: Didn't you say you wanted to see the Lightbearer knights in action, Master Pang?
say:47:1460115044:1.female: Didn't you say you wanted to see the Lightbearer knights in action, Master Pang?

say:48:1460115045:1.text: How did you even hear about that...? Aside from asking locals when I arrived, I only brought it up once earlier.
say:48:1460115045:1.source_cn: 居然知道这个……我除了刚抵达此处时询问过当地人之外，也...

say:49:1460115046:1.text: Valen's info network is terrifying... So, what now?
say:49:1460115046:1.source_cn: 维伦的情报能力还真是厉害呢……那么，该怎么办？
say:49:1460115046:1.male: Valen's info network is terrifying... So, what now?
say:49:1460115046:1.female: Valen's info network is terrifying... So, what now?

choice_prompt:50:1460115046.source_cn: 维伦的情报能力还真是厉害呢……那么，该怎么办？
choice_prompt:50:1460115046.male: Valen's info network is terrifying... So, what now?
choice_prompt:50:1460115046.female: Valen's info network is terrifying... So, what now?

say:51:1460115047:1.text: Excellent! I was waiting for you to say that!
say:51:1460115047:1.source_cn: 好极了，就等着你这句话！
say:51:1460115047:1.male: Excellent! I was waiting for you to say that!
say:51:1460115047:1.female: Excellent! I was waiting for you to say that!

choice:43:0:1.text: You really are just loafing around!
choice:43:0:1.male: You really are just loafing around!
choice:43:0:1.female: You really are just loafing around!

say:53:1460115041:1.text: Come on, Magister. Can't a poor knight have a little fun on his break?
say:53:1460115041:1.source_cn: 忙碌的大魔法师看起来见不得可怜骑士的休闲时光啊。
say:53:1460115041:1.male: Come on, Magister. Can't a poor knight have a little fun on his break?
say:53:1460115041:1.female: Come on, Magister. Can't a poor knight have a little fun on his break?

choice:43:1:2.text: Makes me not want to humor you.
choice:43:1:2.male: Makes me not want to humor you.
choice:43:1:2.female: Makes me not want to humor you.

say:54:1460115036:1.text: Oh, I have even more info for you then! But not for free.
say:54:1460115036:1.source_cn: 真的吗？那接下来的情报一定值，只是绝对不能免费供应了。
say:54:1460115036:1.male: Oh, I have even more info for you then! But not for free.
say:54:1460115036:1.female: Oh, I have even more info for you then! But not for free.

say:55:1460115030:0.text: Now we're talking. But intel like this doesn't come cheap. One round of your finest, Magister.
say:55:1460115030:0.source_cn: 当然可以，不过我的情报可不是免费的，所以等会儿你要请我...
say:55:1460115030:0.male: Now we're talking. But intel like this doesn't come cheap. One round of your finest, Magister.
say:55:1460115030:0.female: Now we're talking. But intel like this doesn't come cheap. One round of your finest, Magister.

say:56:1460115023:2.text: I'm honored that you understand. It truly is like solving a puzzle of logic and patience.
say:56:1460115023:2.source_cn: 能得到你的理解真是很荣幸，我想，这就和做数学证明是一样的。
